summary: Isolate the reserved fixture instance behind its own paired-client Fabric service and inbound-only peer namespace.

replay.detail: No stored claim replay is required.

schema.detail: The client wire protocol and generated schemas are unchanged.

rules.detail: Fixture exposure accepts only the client-control-fixture service and paired client socket; production exposure and fixture peer grants stay separate.

compatibility.detail: Normal instances retain st3-client-v0 and existing client alias behavior.

downtime.detail: Source changes do not configure or restart Fabric or daemon services.

manual.detail: Any fixture exposure or peer addition requires separately reviewed scope and authorization before use.

recovery.detail: Remove each fixture peer and the fixture exposure independently while preserving normal peers and exposure.
